tasks.title: trim/ripple/roll/slip/slide联动编辑
tasks.implementedScope: Single-track original edits plus linked video+audio split/move/non-ripple trim/slip/delete, prechecked partner locks, collision/source/grid failure atomicity, actual source-origin offsets and1000 exact trim/inverse operations. Unlink preserves both clips; selected-audio split allocates real immutable versions. Caption-aware SlipClip is officially admitted on the persist path: sourceRange.start moves by the source delta; timelineRange, TimeMap shape, and sequence duration stay unchanged; clipLocal and absolute cues stay put; source-anchored cues reproject while the source window still covers them; uncovering a source cue, a source head/tail shortfall, or a locked sourceRange is whole-group ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE / SOURCE_OUT_OF_RANGE / FIELD_LOCKED. Caption-aware RollCut is officially admitted on the persist path: a packed adjacent cut moves by the timeline delta; left duration and later source grow, the right start and source window shrink, outer ends and sequence duration stay fixed; clipLocal on the left stays put, clipLocal on the right follows the right start, source-anchored cues reproject while still covered, and absolute cues stay at author time; a non-adjacent cut, uncovering a source cue, a source shortfall, or a locked field is whole-group NOT_ADJACENT / ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE / SOURCE_OUT_OF_RANGE / FIELD_LOCKED. Linked AV still slips link-group members together by the same source delta, and rolls members at the same cut with each stream's source rate. Official workbench Slip and Roll buttons issue one SlipClip or RollCut. Caption-aware SlideClip is officially admitted on the persist path: a packed adjacent triple slides by the timeline delta; left duration and later source grow, the middle start moves while its duration and sourceRange stay, the right start and source window shrink, the left start and outer end and sequence duration stay fixed; clipLocal on the left stays put, clipLocal on the middle and right follow the moved starts, source-anchored cues reproject while still covered, and absolute cues stay at author time; a non-adjacent triple, uncovering a source cue, a source shortfall, or a locked field is whole-group NOT_ADJACENT / ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE / SOURCE_OUT_OF_RANGE / FIELD_LOCKED. Linked AV still slides members of the same packed triple with each stream's source rate. Official workbench Slide button issues one SlideClip. Increment 1.84 officializes the I-006 acceptance item for 1000 seeded random legal inputs (seed 0x16061E84, distinct from the I-005 undo suite and the 1000 slip/inverse cases): length and source-range conservation follows the original s3 meaning (linear sourceDuration equals rate times timelineDuration, sourceRange stays inside the available stream, sequence duration equals the item and caption cover, slip/roll/slide keep the documented outer-end and sequence-duration invariants, leave-gap trim does not delete a neighbor, source media hashes stay put), applyEdit stays pure, and official refusals leave the document unchanged (no half-write). The existing I-005 1000-random undo suite is not this acceptance and was not reused. Increment 1.85 officializes the I-006 trim-mode matrix for every already-admitted mode (leave-gap TrimClip in/out shorten and lengthen-into-gap, RippleTrimClip in/out shorten and lengthen, SlipClip, RollCut, and SlideClip): source handles stay inside the available stream and a shortfall is whole-command SOURCE_OUT_OF_RANGE or the existing INVALID_RANGE; leave-gap lengthen into a neighbor is COLLISION and does not delete the neighbor; linked AV stays a whole group; a locked host track, locked linked audio partner, or locked sourceRange is whole-group FIELD_LOCKED and does not half-write. A locked syncLock track required to move on a default insert ripple is SYNC_LOCKED and does not half-write; clearing syncLock on a locked track is allowed and excludes that track from the default set. Optical-flow and other non-linear interpolation modes are RETIME_INTERP_UNSUPPORTED and cannot steal duration. All snapshots/undo/revisions/roles/blob pins/resources retained; current/latest/save/named/session/other-project roots and shared DB authority protected. Real SIGKILL/SQL-audit fault/final-authority rollback, stale review/fence, actual media/archive/reopen tests. Default preserveAll, explicit keep-count only; full age-window/backups/resource compaction and original remaining acceptance remain unfinished. Increment1.10: separate native read-only file resource view, explicit core font/mask/image/source/generated/evidence references and opaque library/LUT diagnostics; actual granted bytes hash/size collection, new JSON/archive publication, separate-process reopen and narrow registered-ID read-only fork. Default writable editor/archive gates unchanged, no SQLite/CAS/pin mutation. Integrity is not format/render qualification. Unknown/retained definition walkers, writable resource-aware admission/rendering and persistent ImportMap remain unfinished; no full-task completion. Increment1.11: original full-Project2 retained definition reference qualification (exact origin/kind/id/version, declared/pinned nested closure, hash/strict JSON/depth/count/opaque diagnostics) supports actual read-only collect/archive/reopen, NOT retained rendering/full resolved definition equivalence. Explicit native resource UI now opens NEW writable forks only for the existing renderer profile after all declared bytes, actual probe/first video frame/1024-sample PCM/proxy qualification and final CAS/writer/selected-head fences. SQLitev9 ImportMap plus create/definitions/pins/selection/writer/checkpoint are atomic; real SQL late failure and SIGKILL rollback, reopen/edit/AAC export, budget/cancel/revision and actual v4-v8 migration/runtime-refusal tested. Typed registered IDs only; unknown/font/mask/image/LUT/library/retained execution remains readonly/refused, never stripped. Full original acceptance/history/session/renderer qualification remains unfinished. Increment1.12: typed exact frozen/current resolved definition identity includes source blob/effect/font/mask/image hierarchy and actual unversioned AudioBus dependencies; project-title/reverse-parent edges excluded. Same media version with changed resolved dependencies rejects full-snapshot resource qualification; current-head SQL publication guard rejects unchanged sequence version dependency edits. Fixed actual SetMasterAudio sequence-version propagation, duplicate stays no-op. Resource UI exposes identity/unqualified code with no render-equivalence proof. Explicit unqualified transitions/track-sequence effect ordering/extensions preserve opaque data, no writable renderer expansion. Actual DSP PCM/Chrome and selected native/SQL/UI regressions recorded per frozen source; historical legacy SQL hashes/noncurrent version reuse, full resource/render equivalence, migration/session history and full original acceptance remain unfinished. Increment1.13: current guarded writer reconstructs known typed historical definitions from exact hash/ns/project/revision-checked anchored roots, including noncurrent versions; bare/orphan raw hashes cannot certify reuse. Old raw rows/snapshots/counters remain unchanged; valid canonical-equivalent parent/raw differences permitted only with historical proof. Actual legacy ambiguous bus/sequence history stays readable; only exact validated undo can restore alternate ambiguous states, not arbitrary new writes. Bounded one-project cache16384/zero-cache source streaming, rollback and other-connection invalidation tested. Actual old06a2545 store AND document libraries plus explicit instrumented-temp SIGKILL/unmodified reopen, SQL failure/corruption/counter/orphan/cache/archive/fork tests. Schema9 remains: old executable co-writers are not fenced. Full I-002/I-022/story/session/unknown resource execution remains unfinished. Increment 1.92 officializes the I-013 remainingAcceptance item 「凭据/已删正文不入包」 at the already-admitted embedded ProjectArchive bound: official packages carry only the frozen current snapshot and declared blobs, manifest.sessionArchive stays null, and superseded document body, sessions, credentials, and the command journal are not zip entries. After a committed title change, the store still holds the superseded body in an earlier snapshot, but a current-revision archive does not include it. A planted non-null sessionArchive carrying credentials is refused as ARCHIVE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED and does not rewrite the already-published package. Existing files_test.dart, save_test.dart, and save_crash_test.dart are not reused or rewritten. 「运行job归档固定rev并报告pending」 is not officialized (job archival and pending-job reports remain unfinished and are not invented). 「不可打包资源显式manifest」 is not officialized (the admitted embedded opener requires missingExternalRefs to be empty and does not open packMode=linked). 「取消无半包发布」 and 「保留策略不删可达blob」 are already official in save_test.dart and files_test.dart / checkpoint-retention suites and are not re-qualified. Increment 2.50 officializes leftover 「不可打包资源显式manifest」 on the already-admitted ProjectArchive: ArchiveOptions.mode originals/proxies/linked; proxies and linked publish packMode=linked with missingExternalRefs listing omitted original Asset IDs; those originals are not zip entries; sourceCompleteness is never selfContained merely because a ZIP was written; proxyOnly is only a sourceCompleteness value and a planted packMode=proxyOnly is ARCHIVE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED; opening a linked package sets needsRelink and does not fetch locators; default originals save stays embedded and still refuses a non-null locator; sessionArchive stays null. Official suite test/i013_unpackable_manifest_test.dart (3). Frozen Increment 1.92 I-013 and 1.93 I-014 suites are not rewritten. Job archival is not invented. 「取消无半包发布」 and 「保留策略不删可达blob」 are not re-qualified. Increment 3.06 officializes DEV-PURE ArtifactKindAdmission in packages/studio_artifact_kind_probe: backup, logicalArchive, portableArchive, finishedExport, and sync are distinct artifacts; a finished export used as an editable project is EXPORT_NOT_EDITABLE_PROJECT; claiming a device sync without a sync kind and a remote ACK is PROVIDER_WRITTEN_NOT_SYNCED; an unknown kind is ARTIFACT_KIND_UNKNOWN. This does not invent job archival, a muxer, or packMode=proxyOnly, and does not rewrite Increment 2.50 packMode, Increment 2.86 ProxyDeliveryAdmission, Increment 3.05 PackageAutoUpdateAdmission, or official I-024 export suites. An I-014 RestoreService is not invented. Evidence: evidence/i013-artifact-kind/. ADR 0205. Increment 3.18 officializes DEV-PURE PackageProjectionAdmission in packages/studio_package_projection_probe: models/references, index, and thumbnail are admitted as snapshot projections that are not a second source of truth and must not overwrite the snapshot body; an unknown kind is PACKAGE_PROJECTION_KIND_UNKNOWN; a projection that does not match the real snapshot is PACKAGE_PROJECTION_MISMATCH; overwriting the snapshot body is SNAPSHOT_BODY_OVERWRITE_FORBIDDEN. This does not rewrite Increment 2.50 packMode / sourceCompleteness, Increment 3.06 ArtifactKindAdmission, or MANIFEST_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH in project_archive.dart. The PENDING_MEDIA / RESOURCE_MISSING “do not mislabel a complete archive or final render” half of the same s5c row is not officialized here. “Missing models must not auto-download” is not re-qualified. Job archival, a muxer, and an I-014 RestoreService are not invented. Existing I-013 remainingAcceptance wording is not silently cleared. Evidence: evidence/i013-package-projection/. ADR 0217. Increment 3.20 officializes DEV-PURE ArchiveSpaceAdmission in packages/studio_archive_space_probe: archive progress phases scan/collect/write/verify/publish are admitted; an unknown phase is ARCHIVE_PROGRESS_KIND_UNKNOWN; inventing a percentage when total bytes are unknown is UNKNOWN_BYTES_PERCENT_FORBIDDEN; double-counting same-hash media in CAS accounting is CAS_HASH_DOUBLE_COUNT_FORBIDDEN; assuming a cross-volume rename is CROSS_VOLUME_RENAME_NOT_ASSUMED. This is planner accounting, not a re-qualification of I-004 same-hash single blob, I-042 LEASE_DOUBLE_COUNT, Increment 2.50 packMode, Increment 3.06 ArtifactKindAdmission, Increment 3.18 PackageProjectionAdmission, or I-013 cancel-with-no-half-published-package. ENOSPC is not claimed. A ZipPlanner, a muxer, job archival, a StoragePort runtime, and an I-014 RestoreService are not invented. The same s5d row’s unknown-target conservative new-file, cancel-before-publish, and ZIP_STORED clauses are not officialized here. Existing I-013 remainingAcceptance wording is not silently cleared. Evidence: evidence/i013-archive-space/. ADR 0219. Increment 3.24 officializes DEV-PURE SessionExportAdmission in packages/studio_session_export_probe: when session content is omitted, contentRefs must be redacted placeholder IDs and body blobs are not retained (SESSION_BODY_BLOB_FORBIDDEN, SESSION_CONTENT_NOT_REDACTED); command bodies are not exported (COMMAND_BODY_NOT_EXPORTED); runs must be historical or interruptedOnExport, not live (RUN_MUST_BE_HISTORICAL); an unknown kind is SESSION_EXPORT_KIND_UNKNOWN. This does not rewrite Increment 1.92 / ADR 0099 default session and command-journal exclusion, Increment 3.22 AuditJournalAdmission, ADR 0018 no job-resume binding, or I-054 default-diagnostic exclusions. The “package must not mix in a temporary session database” and “import must not resume side effects” sentences are not officialized here. Job archival, an I-014 RestoreService, and PatchGroup cherry-pick are not invented. Production FTS/RAG is not claimed. Existing I-013 remainingAcceptance wording is not silently cleared. Evidence: evidence/i013-session-export/. ADR 0223. Increment 3.25 officializes DEV-PURE PackageStagingAdmission in packages/studio_package_staging_probe: a package is admitted only from clean staging; reusing a previous session-containing directory is STALE_SESSION_DIRECTORY_FORBIDDEN; casually packing a generic cache is CASUAL_CACHE_PACK_FORBIDDEN; including analysis evidence without both explicit selection and permission is ANALYSIS_EVIDENCE_CONSENT_REQUIRED; a build that is not from clean staging is CLEAN_STAGING_REQUIRED; an unknown kind is PACKAGE_STAGING_KIND_UNKNOWN. This does not rewrite Increment 3.24 SessionExportAdmission, Increment 1.92 / ADR 0099 default session exclusion, Increment 3.22 AuditJournalAdmission, or ADR 0018 no job-resume binding. The “package must not mix in a temporary session database” and “import must not resume side effects” sentences are not officialized here. Job archival and an I-014 RestoreService are not invented. Production FTS/RAG is not claimed. Existing I-013 remainingAcceptance wording is not silently cleared. Evidence: evidence/i013-package-staging/. ADR 0224. Increment 3.26 officializes DEV-PURE HistoryAvailabilityAdmission in packages/studio_history_availability_probe: when history is omitted, only the current revision snapshot is kept; including historical snapshots is HISTORICAL_SNAPSHOT_NOT_INCLUDED; retargeting old references at the current content is OLD_REF_NOT_CURRENT; leaving old references unmarked as unavailable is OLD_REF_NOT_UNAVAILABLE; an unknown kind is HISTORY_AVAILABILITY_KIND_UNKNOWN. This does not re-qualify ADR 0018 ImportMap, “no imported history,” no historical-revision / session / job-resume binding, or fork-new-projectId. A history-selected packer is not invented. Increment 3.25 PackageStagingAdmission, Increment 3.24 SessionExportAdmission, Increment 1.92 / ADR 0099, and Increment 3.22 AuditJournalAdmission are not re-qualified. The “package must not mix in a temporary session database” and “import must not resume side effects” sentences are not officialized here. “片段不在导入集合则scope invalid” and “所有旧审批失效” are not officialized here. Job archival and an I-014 RestoreService are not invented. Existing I-013 remainingAcceptance wording is not silently cleared. Evidence: evidence/i013-history-availability/. ADR 0225. Increment 3.27 officializes DEV-PURE LibraryArchiveAdmission in packages/studio_library_archive_probe: a logical library archive is a list-state change; bumping the project revision is LIBRARY_ARCHIVE_NOT_REVISION; deleting CAS is LIBRARY_ARCHIVE_CAS_DELETE_FORBIDDEN; undoing or resubmitting a cloud job is LIBRARY_ARCHIVE_JOB_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN; opening an archived library as writable is ARCHIVED_LIBRARY_NOT_WRITABLE; auto-attaching a job to an archived document is AUTO_ATTACH_ARCHIVED_FORBIDDEN; restoring to active and accepting candidates without review is CANDIDATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED; an unknown kind is LIBRARY_ARCHIVE_KIND_UNKNOWN. This does not re-qualify Increment 3.06 ArtifactKindAdmission, Increment 3.26 HistoryAvailabilityAdmission, Increment 3.25 PackageStagingAdmission, Increment 3.24 SessionExportAdmission, or I-029 DeletionBarrier. I-013 job archival and an I-014 RestoreService are not invented. The s5e missing-media / finished-export sentences are not officialized here. Schema v10 is not merged. Existing I-013 remainingAcceptance wording is not silently cleared. Evidence: evidence/i013-library-archive/. ADR 0226. Increment 3.28 officializes DEV-PURE ArchiveCountdownAdmission in packages/studio_archive_countdown_probe: a library or portable archive must not start the project-deletion recycle-bin countdown; starting that countdown is ARCHIVE_COUNTDOWN_FORBIDDEN; an unknown kind is ARCHIVE_COUNTDOWN_KIND_UNKNOWN. This does not re-qualify I-029 DeletionBarrier, Increment 3.27 LibraryArchiveAdmission, Increment 3.06 ArtifactKindAdmission, ADR 0016 checkpoint-index retention, or the already-official “保留策略不删可达blob” bound. A recycle-bin runtime is not invented. The 30-day figure remains a design default and is not claimed as a measured timer. The “删除项目另走明确回收站30天” sentence is not officialized here. I-013 job archival and an ArchiveService runtime are not invented. Existing I-013 remainingAcceptance wording is not silently cleared. Evidence: evidence/i013-archive-countdown/. ADR 0227. Increment 3.29 officializes DEV-PURE UnknownExtensionPinAdmission in packages/studio_unknown_extension_pin_probe: when an unknown extension's references cannot be enumerated, failing to pin conservatively is CONSERVATIVE_PIN_REQUIRED and claiming a complete archive is UNKNOWN_EXTENSION_FALSE_COMPLETE; an unknown kind is UNKNOWN_EXTENSION_PIN_KIND_UNKNOWN. This does not re-qualify I-004 same-hash, ADR 0099, I-029 DeletionBarrier, Increment 2.50 packMode / sourceCompleteness, Increment 3.28 ArchiveCountdownAdmission, or Increment 3.27 LibraryArchiveAdmission. The PENDING_MEDIA / RESOURCE_MISSING “do not mislabel a complete archive or final render” sentence is not officialized here. Incremental blob dedup, private session-DB backup exclusion, and privacy-immediate purge are not officialized. A BackupStore runtime is not invented. Existing I-013 remainingAcceptance wording is not silently cleared. I-004 remainingAcceptance is not touched. Evidence: evidence/i013-unknown-extension-pin/. ADR 0228. Increment 3.30 officializes DEV-PURE FixedRevisionArchiveAdmission in packages/studio_fixed_revision_archive_probe: including pending-job future outputs is FUTURE_OUTPUT_NOT_INCLUDED; mutating a published package when a later job completes is PUBLISHED_PACKAGE_IMMUTABLE; canceling a paid job as a side effect of archive is ARCHIVE_PAID_JOB_CANCEL_FORBIDDEN; archiving with pending jobs and no disclosure is PENDING_JOB_DISCLOSURE_REQUIRED; letting in-flight edits affect the archived revision is ARCHIVE_EDIT_NEW_REVISION_ONLY; an unknown kind is FIXED_REVISION_ARCHIVE_KIND_UNKNOWN. This does not invent I-013 job archival and does not re-qualify Increment 3.06 ArtifactKindAdmission, Increment 3.04 JobCancelAdmission, Increment 3.29 UnknownExtensionPinAdmission, or Increment 2.50 packMode. The PENDING_MEDIA complete-archive sentence is not officialized. The “两个独立按钮” sentence is not officialized. Quote/apply and paid APIs are not started. Existing I-013 remainingAcceptance wording is not silently cleared. I-005 remainingAcceptance is not rewritten. Evidence: evidence/i013-fixed-revision-archive/. ADR 0229.
